intent: take a candidate skill from intake to an admitted, eval-gated bundle on main through the machine ceremony

entry_points.description: a SOURCE_PROPOSAL.md under intake/<skill>/ plus a skill bundle under skills/<skill>/ on a branch

states.description: bundle exists on a branch; nothing binds its bytes and main knows nothing about it
intake/<skill>/source-lock.json binds the proposal bytes by sha256
admissions/<skill>.json binds subject-file hashes and the skill tree digest (content-bound receipt)
registry.json, agents-routing.json and the skills hub route the skill
python3 scripts/run_all.py passes with the skill's validator and tests wired in
the bundle is on main: machine-merged PR (app/github-actions) with the Refs issue closed
the full-suite gate fails closed on the candidate with a named error code; main is untouched

transitions.action: generate the source lock binding the proposal sha256
generate the admission receipt with subject-file hashes and tree digest
add the registry entry, routing leaf and hub agent-next
run the full-suite gate (scripts/run_all.py) to PASS
open a PR whose body is exactly 'Refs ed3c/skill-concerns#N' and let trusted verify plus the land workflow merge it
the full-suite gate exits non-zero with a named error code

observables.assertion: the provider reads the PR as MERGED by app/github-actions and the Refs issue as CLOSED
a fresh checkout of main carries the skill bundle, its ADMITTED registry entry and an admission receipt whose tree digest recomputes from the checked-out bytes
the same scripts/run_all.py gate the hosted verify executes exits non-zero printing the exact error code
